title: Trade review 20 Nov: 8 results, 5 lessons
summary: 0 T2, 2 T1 (UNIONBANK +6.22%, INDIANB), 1 failed: AEGISLOG −10.12% at 30 days. 4 new buys; 90 closed trades total +143.1%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Fri 20 Nov: UNIONBANK and INDIANB hit T1, 4 new buys, AEGISLOG failed, 1 missed winner.**

A busy day. AEGISLOG's 30-day exit cost −10.1 points, so all 90 closed trades now total +143.1% (average +1.6%), against +153.2% from 89 last night. Nifty rose 1.12% to 25,800.60. 18 trades are still running, 8 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 108 bought trades is +1.0%. Four new picks were listed (TECHM, NLCINDIA, PREMIERENE, LLOYDSENGG). The next 30-day exits are GOODLUCK (−7.9%), PNGSREVA (−16.3%, T1 booked) and ASTRAL (−8.8%, T1 booked) on Monday 23 Nov.

**Today's results**
- ❌ **AEGISLOG** (Pullback, listed 19 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at the zone top ₹1,318.19 on 21 Oct, best rise only +0.36%; closed at ₹1,184.80, −10.12% (worst −18.05%), 7.4% below its ₹1,279.80 support. The listing chart shows a stock that more than doubled in June and July, then spent three months chopping under the ₹1,424 wall, and printed a big-volume red reversal from near ₹1,500 just before listing; it listed on 0.5× volume in a weakening sector, with T2 (₹1,397) just under the wall. Zone bottom only would have been worse: bought at ₹1,279.80 on 22 Oct, it is still at −15.6%. Like FINCABLES, its run-up came months earlier, so it fell 1.6% in the month before listing.
- ✅ **UNIONBANK** (Candle at support, listed 18 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹206.03 → ₹218.00 in 1 day, no dip at all; now +6.22%, with T2 at ₹224.35. It filled near the zone bottom, which put T1 almost 6% above the fill.
- ✅ **INDIANB** (Candle at support, listed 17 Nov): T1 hit, still open: ₹933.90 → ₹961.92 in 2 days, worst dip −0.02%; now +1.72%. A missed winner when it was listed in October, it paid this time.
- 🟢 **KEI** (Candle at support, listed 19 Nov): bought: Filled at ₹3,795.10, inside the zone; now +0.87%. It traded 3.0% cheaper the same day, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹3,728.70 also filled. It fell 13.9% in the month before listing.
- 🟢 **CGPOWER** (Candle at support, listed 19 Nov): bought: Filled at ₹790.00, just inside the zone top; now +0.25%. It was a missed winner on its 6 Nov listing.
- 🟢 **IRCTC** (Candle at support, listed 19 Nov): bought: Filled at the zone top ₹448.05; flat. A midcap stock in a weakening sector.
- 🟢 **RECLTD** (Candle at support, listed 19 Nov): bought: Filled at the zone top ₹294.79; now +1.12%. Its 30 Oct trade closed at T2 for +6.39%.
- ⚪ **PARAGMILK** (Pullback, listed 17 Nov): never bought, a missed winner: It came within 0.15% of the zone top (₹326.51) but never dipped in. A buy at zone+2% or at the next open (₹331.00 on 18 Nov) would have reached T1 on 19 Nov; it is now −0.9%. It rose 13.2% in the month before listing.

No wins closed today. Plus 60 earlier, among them IDFCFIRSTB, NMDC, SUNDARMFIN, PFC and TMPV (11 Nov). These 70 wins (55 at T2, 15 partial) made +353.5%; with the 20 failures (−210.4% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 90 closed trades total +143.1%. 7 of the 15 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (8): UNIONBANK ₹206.03 → ₹218.00 in 1 day and INDIANB ₹933.90 → ₹961.92 in 2 days (both today), GRANULES (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 4 of these 8 are below their buy price (PNGSREVA −16.3%, ASTRAL −8.8%, ESCORTS −5.9%, ONGC −0.7%).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners now 21 of 33:** PARAGMILK is new tonight. 25 of the 33 never bought came within 2% of the zone. Two former missed winners, INDIANB and CGPOWER, were listed again and bought; INDIANB already reached T1.
- **Better prices inside the window:** KEI traded 3.0% below its fill today; the other new buys filled within 1% of their low. AEGISLOG is a case against buying lower: zone bottom only is still −15.6% on it.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 94% vs 79% as listed: 14.7 points (the bar is 15), closer again. Its 107 closed trades made +171.5%, against +143.1% from 90 as listed, with 24 losing trades against 23.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.1% vs −7.4% as listed, 1.3 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 105 closed trades made +201.1% with 19 losing trades; average closed trade +1.9% against +1.6%.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.3% (closed and open), and their 24 closed trades net −68.6% with 11 of the 20 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 19 retest near misses logged since then: 6 at T1, 5 at T2, best rise 3.7% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** 13 of the 16 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing; AEGISLOG today is the third that did not, and like FINCABLES its big rally came months earlier. Those 40 trades average −3.2% and their 32 closed trades net −106.4%; the other 68 made +249.5% from 58 closed trades, 42 at T2. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (weakening)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 39 of 47 bought reached T1 (83%) and 30 reached T2 (64%); their 36 closed trades made +172.0% with 4 failures, and they dip least (−3.8%). Both of today's T1 hits and all four new buys are from this group. (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 42 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (67%), worst dip −3.1%. 56 cash trades: 19 at T2 (34%), worst dip −11.5%. All three failures this week were cash stocks or a falling F&O stock (VMM). (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 21 of 33 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open (PARAGMILK tonight); 25 of the 33 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small. (holding)

**Early sign, from a tracker group:** picks with trigger volume under 1.5× reach T2 less often (41 of 85, 48%; worst dip −7.8%) than those at 1.5–2.5× (10 of 15, 67%; −3.7%), and all three failures this week listed on 0.4–0.6× volume. The stronger group has only 15 trades, so it is not a change yet. Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (48 of 48).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Zone up to 2% above gets 14.7 points more fills against a bar of 15, with more T1 hits (97 vs 74); it qualifies once it clears 15 points with T1 holding. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+201.1% vs +143.1%), but its dip gain is 1.3 points against a bar of 2.

**Bug check:** nothing found. 108 bought = 55 at T2 + 15 partial + 20 failed + 18 running; T1 hit 78 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only price changes against last night are the four new fills.
